findings.F1: The book is long-only and earns less than holding (Sharpe 0.376, which is 0.193 below holding's), because the coin keeps rising while the book is flat: next-day coin return is +0.089% on flat bars against +0.157% on active bars, flat bars make up 42% of all bars, and in 2020, 2023 and 2024 flat bars rose more than active bars (+0.71% vs +0.30%, +0.28% vs +0.06%, +0.40% vs +0.18% per day).
findings.F2: The drift does not start at the cross. In the first 20 bars after the 50-day SMA rises above the 200-day, the forward 10-bar return is -1.03%; at 20 to 60 bars of age it is +2.97%. In the first 20 bars after a down-cross, while the book is flat, it is +2.09%. Moves right after a cross reverse.
findings.F3: A larger forecast does not earn more. Forward 10-bar return by forecast bucket is 1.46% (0-5), 1.67% (5-10), 0.81% (10-15) and 0.49% (15-20), then 2.38% at the cap. Over non-overlapping blocks the slope has t = 0.37.
findings.F4: Inside an up-trend, 60-bar momentum separates winners from losers. In the lowest 60-bar-return tercile the forward 10-bar return is -0.55%; in the middle tercile it is +3.72% and in the top tercile +1.49%.
findings.F5: Active-bar gains are concentrated in volatile and strongly rising states. Next-day book return is 0.37% in the highest-volatility tercile against 0.07% in the low and middle terciles, and 0.39% in the top 20-day-return tercile against 0.05% to 0.08% in the others.
findings.F6: Fees are not the cause; whipsaws are. The 1091 trades have a mean gross gain of +0.87% against about 0.1% commission each. Trades held 40 days or less (635 of them) lose -10.1% gross each, while those held longer than 40 days gain +16.1%. The per-window book drawdown reaches -96% (XRP) and -93% (ZEC), which makes the Calmar ratio 0.001.

ideas.idea: When a coin's 50-day SMA has stayed above its 200-day SMA for more than about 20 bars, the price keeps rising over the next 10 bars more than it does in the first 20 bars after the up-cross.
ideas.consequence: A trader would skip the first weeks after a golden cross and take the long only once the trend has lasted about a month.
ideas.name: mature golden cross drift

ideas.idea: In the first 20 bars after a coin's 50-day SMA crosses below its 200-day SMA, the price rises over the next 10 bars.
ideas.consequence: A trader would treat a fresh death cross as an exhausted down-move and stay long, or buy it, instead of exiting.
ideas.name: fresh death cross rebounds

ideas.idea: While a coin's 50-day SMA is above its 200-day SMA, the price keeps rising over the next 10 bars when the coin's own 60-day return is not among its weakest, and it falls when the 60-day return is among its weakest.
ideas.consequence: A trader would refuse longs inside an up-trend whose price has stalled over the last 60 days.
ideas.name: momentum-confirmed uptrend continuation

ideas.idea: While a coin's 50-day SMA is above its 200-day SMA, the next-day rise is larger when the coin's recent 20-day volatility and 20-day return are high for that coin.
ideas.consequence: A trader would size the trend long by how fast and how volatile the rise is, not by the gap between the averages.
ideas.name: volatile strong uptrend pays
